question: What event count is sufficient for two 2e-6 complex overlap measurements, and can reference drift spoil calibrated geometric phase?

objects.object_type: complex overlap of rank14 real J carrier
objects.definition: sum rk exp(i2gkt) under time-independent Euclidean skew G
[1+Re(exp(-i beta)Z)]/2 with four quadratures at each of two delays

assumptions.description: eight independent Bernoulli streams, m trials per setting, known analyzer phases; no systematic detector or state drift
untracked external phase reference may differ at final endpoint from calibration probes

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: eight settings, exact count and rational Taylor certificate
reference rotation affects corrected phase but not overlap magnitude
no relevant divisibility or boundary question

clock_receipt.clock_type: continuous native clock, physical tau0 OPEN
clock_receipt.update_rule: x'=Gx; measured Z rotates by exp(i theta_ref)
clock_receipt.initial_phase: probe frame fixed, main frame possibly shifted

dynamics_readout.state_space: rank14 active carrier + 8 Bernoulli sample streams
dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: G=sum gk Kk, separate readout frame
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: G norm-preserving, photon counting independent assumption
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: four quadrature estimates; visibility insensitive to frame drift

target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: one ideal IID Bernoulli receiver, one adversarial drift stress
target_exposure.selection_criterion: Hoeffding sufficient 99% and investigate potential failure

calculation_steps: Eight Bernoulli means within eta/(2sqrt2) imply both two-quadrature complex errors<=eta.
m=7.4e12 and eta=1/500000 yield m eta²/4=37/5; rational 13th Taylor sum for exp(37/5)>1600 -> failure<1/100.
Total count 8m=59.2e12; not optimal and no physical evidence.
Unobserved theta_ref(T)=1/500 with zero theta_ref on probes rotates only final Z; contrast unchanged.
Calibration spare margin/(Tmax)=2014132175737/351475200000000000 rad/native; plus step raises previous upper budget to 0.010214198086935355.

result.approximation: tail 0.009780044178; drift margin 5.73051e-6 rad/native; with bias upper budget 0.01021419808694rad
result.precision_and_error: exact rational and known concentration inequality; numeric exponent/rate durations for context

counterexamples_and_failures: If reference phase is unobserved at main endpoint, corrected signal phase is ambiguous despite unchanged visibility.
99% confidence under IID assumptions is not absolute noise bound.
limitations: No measured detector count, tau0, clock or reference drift.
Shot count is a sufficient model bound not physical minimum.
next_discriminant: Test real receiver phase-frame stability, correlated photodetection and independent conventional null.
